title: DomainsConfigFile
description: Sparse team file .marshall/config/domains.json: overrides only where the derived domain detection (setup.detect-domains) is wrong for the repository.

enabled.description: Forced activation; absent = derived. Server rule: a known compiled or project-local domain.

file_globs.description: Replaces the descriptor's detection globs. Server rule: parses in the detection dialect; a glob matching no tracked file is a warning finding.

disabled_profiles.description: Profiles never activated for this domain; active profiles are otherwise derived per module.
